debit.notes: Call the toll-free Call Center 18004256708 from your registered mobile number to block a lost/stolen/damaged debit card, or visit your home branch; per the bank's Customer Advisory FAQ (eAPGB & eAPGVB to APGB migration, v3.0 dated 10-10-2025) this is the documented blocking procedure, and the toll-free numbers printed on erstwhile eAPGB/eAPGVB debit cards no longer work post-migration. The Call Center is available 24/7. Internet banking at https://netbanking.apgb.bank.in/ (linked as 'Click Here' from the bank's NetBanking page) has a 'Debit Card Services' page, and the mobile banking app 'APGB Money' has a 'Debit Card Services' menu, both documented in the same advisory for card services; no SMS block keyword is published on the bank's pages. The bank's cyber-security page asks customers to report cyber crime by dialling 1930 or visiting www.cybercrime.gov.in / https://sancharsaathi.gov.in/. No overseas helpline is published on these pages.

credit.notes: No credit-card programme or credit-card-specific blocking channel appears anywhere on the bank's official pages fetched live on 2026-10-31 (homepage, NetBanking page, cyber-security page and the Customer Advisory FAQ); only RuPay debit (ATM) card procedures are documented, so credit-card blocking is not offered/not documented by this bank. Customers would use the same 24/7 Call Center 18004256708 or home-branch channels.
